# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_VOLUME_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts (low ATR-based width) indicating low volatility, a breakout above the ribbon with elevated volume signals new institutional participation and likely continuation. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede institutional accumulation, and a volume-confirmed breakout suggests genuine demand rather than random noise.

## Mechanism

Calculate ribbon width as (highest EMA - lowest EMA) / ATR(14) using 5-minute bars. If width < 0.5 for two consecutive bars, and the close of the current bar > highest EMA with volume > 1.5 * average volume of the last 20 bars, then go long at the next bar open. Exit: initial stop at the lowest EMA of the entry bar; target 1.5R; if price reaches 1R, trail stop to break-even then use a chandelier trail (ATR*3) for runner. Regime hints: VIX < 18 and 09:45-11:30 EST; avoid when ribbon width > 1.0.
